model_inputs.structure_note: Value is carried by the 4-segment driver build (segment_build: Medical Devices incl. CGM, Diagnostics incl. Exact/Cancer Dx, Nutrition, EPD; unallocated corporate cost, Exact amortization and recurring specified items in corporate_ebit) valued with two horizon multiples: P/E 17.0x on our own NTM adjusted EPS $6.39 (w 0.6; the EPS bridge reconciles to the FY2026 guide and includes net interest and other income) and EV/EBITDA 13.5x on the build's NTM EBITDA (operating basis, w 0.4). Litigation (NEC expected, Libre at p 0.5) is an explicit after-tax equity adjustment; the Aug-2026 NEC and Sep-2026 DOJ settlement cash and the FY2027 spin charges run through other_uses. The base keeps ABT consolidated (the Nutrition spin is value-neutral to holders); the ladder carries a 10% branch where the spin completes before the horizon and the ABT quote drops by NutritionCo's ~$8.5/share. No DCF leg (ABT not in dcf_policy.name_weights). No SOTP leg (no sourced forward multiples for nutrition and branded-generic peers). Leg weights are judgment (P/E favoured per the playbook evidence).
model_inputs.gap_note: Flags for Kilian: (1) NEC -$0.9B is low-confidence (range -$0.6B to -$1.2B; tail $3-5B in the bear case). (2) NTM EPS $6.39 is 3.3% below consensus $6.61. (3) Q3 2026 balance sheet is not in the release; net debt is the 2026-06-30 10-Q figure with H2 legal cash in other_uses. (4) Basis: EBIT GAAP after SBC and amortization, excluding litigation; the P/E leg uses stated adjusted EPS (ex-amortization, after SBC) to match peers' consensus basis. (5) Spin timing branch (10%) is judgment from precedent (Abbott/AbbVie announced Oct-2011, completed 2013-01-01).
